mapping_rationale: Restricted advanced-computing shipments faced licensing barriers and NVIDIA reported no licenses for specified restricted China products plus a China Data Center revenue share below pre-control levels, but subsequent 2023 control updates and product redesign/adaptation prevent clean attribution to the October 2022 rule alone.

The corridor restored large physical export flows and food-price indicators moved in the direction consistent with reduced logistics pressure, but FAO identified multiple contributing market/seasonal factors and the hypothesis lacked a numeric success target.

Post-control export interruption and price pressure are consistent with the IEA concentration-risk mechanism, but USGS also identified demand conditions and other market factors alongside availability concerns, so clean single-cause attribution is not asserted.

Drilling-related tension and restrictive measures persisted, but competing maritime, sovereignty and hydrocarbon-rights claims remained unresolved and the later sanctions renewal does not adjudicate those claims or establish a measurable economic outcome.

European battery capacity and direct employment expanded in the expected policy-supported direction, but the later sector outcome reflects demand growth, emissions policy, multiple IPCEIs and other public/private investment rather than the first battery IPCEI alone.

CBAM successfully transitioned from reporting pilot to definitive operation and generated measurable administrative/import volumes, but the admitted January 2026 evidence does not yet resolve UNCTAD's modeled medium-term trade-reallocation, developing-country export and global-emissions effects.

Russian hard-coal imports collapsed and supplier diversification occurred in the expected direction, but the case bundle also contains a port-restriction leg and the broader coal-market reallocation reflected multiple sanctions, energy-security and market factors; the evidence therefore supports only partial realization.

Russian petroleum-oil flows to the EU fell sharply and alternative suppliers gained share in the expected reallocation direction, but the observed trade shift reflects sanctions, war-related adjustments and market responses rather than a single isolated cause.

Uniper's financial position improved dramatically in 2023, consistent with stabilization, but Uniper attributed the result to several factors including commodity-price changes, hedging, gas-portfolio optimization and non-recurrence of replacement-procurement costs; recapitalisation is therefore not treated as the sole cause.

The terminal operated materially and supplied measurable gas volumes in the expected direction, but 'high utilization' and supply-security contribution were not defined as a numeric success threshold and system-level security attribution is multi-factor.

The regulation produced a large reduction in shipping sulfur-oxide emissions consistent with the expected health/welfare mechanism, but the independent historical hypothesis did not define a numeric outcome target.

The dispute moved toward normalization and Korea withdrew its WTO complaint, but Korean MOTIE described Japan as suspending the three-item regulations while Japanese METI stated that the measures should not be understood as lifted and white-list status had not yet been restored. HYDRA preserves the conflicting characterization.

The certification-block mechanism persisted in the expected direction, but the later halt arose from a separate security-of-supply reassessment rather than solely from the German-law organizational conditions identified in November 2021.

The continuing drought-related trade restriction mechanism was observed in the expected direction, with UNCTAD later reporting a 36 percent year-over-year transit reduction, but this mapping does not treat the separate 18-ships-per-day operating projection as the success target of the selected qualitative hypothesis.

Food-price inflation accelerated in the expected direction, but FAO explicitly attributed the observed rise to both ruble depreciation and the food embargo; the embargo is therefore not treated as a sole cause.

Congestion/backlog and freight-pressure mechanisms were observed in the expected direction, but the hypothesis did not contain a numeric success target and freight-market attribution was not cleanly isolated from the wider disrupted market.

Tariff-related input-price pressure and supply disruption appeared in the expected direction, and USITC later estimated causal effects on imports, prices and domestic production, but the historical hypothesis did not define a numeric success target.

By August 2024 the CHIPS program had generated substantial proposed investment and new-facility commitments in the expected direction, but the historical hypothesis used a ten-year horizon and the admitted evidence is an interim implementation snapshot rather than a complete outcome window.

Venezuelan crude production continued declining in the expected direction, but EIA explicitly identified sanctions alongside power outages, mismanagement, staffing and service-company losses, so single-cause attribution to PDVSA sanctions is not asserted.

Tariff-related steel price pressure anticipated by Federal Reserve contacts was later supported by USITC causal estimates of higher steel prices, lower affected imports and higher domestic production, but the historical hypothesis did not specify a numeric success target.

Large clean-energy manufacturing investment occurred in the expected direction and Treasury identified 45X as a major driver, but DOE's historical mechanism was explicitly described alongside domestic-content and other complementary incentives, so single-policy attribution is not clean.

The challenged duties, quotas and specified trading-right restrictions were reported removed, but the WTO record preserves a U.S. concern that a remaining licensing requirement could itself restrict exports and records disagreement over full compliance. The case therefore remains UNEVALUABLE rather than forcing a compliance verdict.
